research_question: What is the effect of bevacizumab biosimilar compared with bevacizumab originator on progression-free survival in adults with cancer?
outcome_description: Progression-free survival (PFS) assessed as hazard ratio (HR) of disease progression or death.
positive_direction: Favorable progression-free survival for bevacizumab biosimilar (lower hazard of disease progression or death compared to originator bevacizumab).
search_queries: bevacizumab biosimilar originator progression-free survival trial
bevacizumab biosimilar reference product cancer comparative trial
bevacizumab biosimilar randomized controlled trial progression-free survival
inclusion_criteria: Comparative clinical trials or randomized controlled trials evaluating adult cancer patients.
Direct comparison of any bevacizumab biosimilar to originator (reference) bevacizumab.
Quantitative progression-free survival data reported as hazard ratios with confidence intervals or standard errors.
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative reviews, conference abstracts without extractable data, editorials, and commentary).
No direct comparison between a bevacizumab biosimilar and originator bevacizumab.
No quantitative outcome data that can produce a progression-free survival hazard ratio and associated measure of variance (95% CI or SE).
Preclinical, in vitro, animal studies, or studies completely unrelated to bevacizumab biosimilar evaluation in cancer.
moderators_to_extract: cancer type and stage (e.g., advanced non-small cell lung cancer, metastatic colorectal cancer)
specific biosimilar agent / investigational product name
effect_size_note: Hazard ratios (HR) and corresponding 95% confidence intervals or standard errors extracted directly from trial-reported Cox proportional hazards survival models for progression-free survival.
